thesis: JTX self-custody Solana trading platform (announced May 5 at Solana Accelerate) launches July 2026 with 80% of protocol revenue directed to open-market JTO buybacks — first direct value mechanism for the token. Trending on CoinGecko at +36% 24h / +39% 7d with vol/mcap 0.94 confirming real bid not stale rotation. Wrong if JTX launch slips past Q3 or buyback mechanism dilutes — annual emissions $96-128M still outpace projected $19-30M buybacks, so a soft launch invalidates the cashflow thesis.
